title: Netflix TV v1.2.0
changelog: Settings Page now directly in primary sidebar navigation with full TV remote D-pad focus and controls
Completely eliminated playback ads, popups, and robot verification checks (Turnstile gates)
Replaced broken embed servers with high-speed, ad-free stream servers (SmashyStream & VidSrc PM)
Hardened Android TV WebView sandbox to block all third-party ad networks and external redirects
Instant update detection with in-app download and installation
